# LA School Report

> > Independent journalism covering Los Angeles Unified School District news, California education policy, and K-12 accountability with investigative reporting on district leadership and education funding.

LA School Report provides comprehensive coverage of LAUSD operations, California education policy, and systemic issues affecting public schools. The site combines breaking news on district leadership with in-depth investigations into education funding, student data privacy, and emerging technologies in classrooms.

## Key Topics

- LAUSD
- Los Angeles Unified School District
- California education policy
- School board
- Superintendent Alberto Carvalho
- FBI investigation
- Education funding
- Budget deficits
- School accountability
- Student data privacy
- AI in education
- Teacher unions
- District leadership
- Education policy

## LAUSD Leadership & Investigations

- [LAUSD School Board Delays Decision on Superintendent Carvalho After FBI Raids](https://www.laschoolreport.com/lausd-school-board-delays-decision-on-superintendent-carvalho-after-fbi-raids): Coverage of FBI investigation into LAUSD Superintendent Alberto Carvalho
- [FBI Raid of L.A. Supe Carvalho's Home, Office May Be Linked to Defunct AI Startup](https://www.laschoolreport.com/fbi-raid-of-l-a-supe-carvalhos-home-office-may-be-linked-to-defunct-ai-startup): FBI investigation of LAUSD Superintendent Carvalho and AI startup connections
- [AllHere Set Meeting With LAUSD Leaders Months Before Landing $6.2M Chatbot Deal](https://www.laschoolreport.com/allhere-set-meeting-with-lausd-leaders-months-before-landing-6-2m-chatbot-deal): Investigation into AllHere AI chatbot contract and FBI investigation of LAUSD

## LAUSD Performance & Operations

- [Historic Los Angeles Testing Gains Lift Even the Lowest-Performing Schools](https://www.laschoolreport.com/historic-los-angeles-testing-gains-lift-even-the-lowest-performing-schools): Report on LAUSD test score improvements and school performance gains
- [LAUSD Approves Resolution to Avoid Vendors Tied to Federal Immigration Enforcement](https://www.laschoolreport.com/lausd-approves-resolution-to-avoid-vendors-tied-to-federal-immigration-enforcement): LAUSD board resolution on vendor policies and immigrant student protection

## California Education Policy & Budget

- [California School Districts Issue Thousands of Pink Slips to Close Growing Budget Deficits](https://www.laschoolreport.com/california-school-districts-issue-thousands-of-pink-slips-to-close-growing-budget-deficits): Report on California school budget crisis and teacher layoffs from EdSource
- [California's Kitchen Nightmare: Union Demands Rise as Enrollment Falls](https://www.laschoolreport.com/californias-kitchen-nightmare-union-demands-rise-as-enrollment-falls): Analysis of California teacher union demands amid declining school enrollment
- [States Want to Help Families. The Child Tax Credit Might Be Their Answer](https://www.laschoolreport.com/states-want-to-help-families-the-child-tax-credit-might-be-their-answer): Article on child tax credit as family financial support and education funding

## Education Technology & Data Privacy

- [Despite California Law, Some Tech Companies Still Sell Student Data](https://www.laschoolreport.com/despite-california-law-some-tech-companies-still-sell-student-data): Investigation into student data privacy violations in California schools
- [California Schools Struggle With How or Whether to Use AI Tools in Classroom](https://www.laschoolreport.com/california-schools-struggle-with-how-or-whether-to-use-ai-tools-in-classroom): Analysis of AI tool adoption challenges in California schools from EdSource

## Education & Social Policy

- [San Francisco ethnic studies courses produced major educational benefits](https://www.laschoolreport.com/san-francisco-ethnic-studies-courses-produced-major-educational-benefits-researchers-find-as-country-debates-anti-racist-teaching-in-schools): Research study on antiracist education outcomes in San Francisco schools
- [Supreme Court Sides with California Parents in Gender Identity Case](https://www.laschoolreport.com/supreme-court-sides-with-california-parents-in-gender-identity-case): Supreme Court ruling on parental notification of student gender identity
- [Discussing His Dyslexia, Newsom Steps into K–12 Spotlight](https://www.laschoolreport.com/discussing-his-dyslexia-newsom-steps-into-k-12-spotlight): Article on Governor Newsom's dyslexia and K-12 education policy focus

## Commentary & Analysis

- [Civic Education in California: A Foundation for a Healthy Democracy](https://www.laschoolreport.com/civic-education-in-california-a-foundation-for-a-healthy-democracy): Commentary on civic education and democracy in California schools
- [Education Was Never Meant to Be a Market. It Was Meant to Be a Lifeline.](https://www.laschoolreport.com/education-was-never-meant-to-be-a-market-it-was-meant-to-be-a-lifeline): Commentary on public education funding and indigenous school models
